title: That Face
text: Now the elephant in the room: that face. In most modern fish, the eyes sit on the sides of the head, which gives a wide view for spotting predators.
nxt: Sacabambaspis had its eyes set toward the front of the head. The fossils support that part of the model. Scientists do not agree on exactly what this layout was for.

title: No Jaw
text: The most striking feature of Sacabambaspis is what it did not have: a jaw. It belongs to a group called the jawless fishes.
nxt: Instead of upper and lower jaws that bite, its mouth was a simple opening, surrounded by small plates.
